info.title: API Processings
info.description: Periodic processings: plugins that ingest, transform and publish datasets, their configs and their runs.

skills.name: workflow
skills.description: How to set up and follow processings: find a plugin, create a processing, fill its config, schedule and activate it, trigger it, then follow its runs and diagnose a failed one from its log. Read it before creating or repairing a processing.

oauth2.description: Jeton d'accès délivré par simple-directory. Un jeton sans claim de scope est une session de premier niveau, non restreinte. Un jeton avec scope ne donne accès qu'aux opérations couvertes par ses scopes, dans la limite du rôle de son identité.

scopes.processings: Tous les droits sur les traitements
scopes.processings:read: Lire les traitements du compte, leurs exécutions et leurs journaux
scopes.processings:write: Créer et configurer les traitements, déclencher et arrêter leurs exécutions
scopes.processings:admin: Supprimer les traitements, gérer leurs permissions, leur propriétaire et leur clé de webhook
scopes.all:read: Lire tout ce que permet le rôle, sur tous les services
scopes.all:write: Lire et modifier tout ce que permet le rôle, sur tous les services
scopes.all:admin: Tous les droits que permet le rôle, sur tous les services

id.description: Id of the user that created this processing

name.description: Name of the user that created this processing

config.description: The config of the plugin, its schema is returned by getPluginConfigSchema.

debug.title: Mode debug
debug.description: Capture des logs détaillés (stacks d'erreurs, appels HTTP) réservés aux super-admins, pour diagnostiquer un plugin en erreur.

plugin.description: Registry artefact id of the plugin (e.g. @data-fair-processing-hello-world-1).

oneOf.title: lecture - permet d'accéder aux informations essentielles du traitement dont les logs, mais pas aux informations sensibles
exécution - permet d'accéder aux informations essentielles du traitement et de déclencher le traitement

id.description: Id of the user that last updated this processing

name.description: Name of the user that last updated this processing

date.description: Date of the last update for this processing

lastRun.description: The last run of the processing.

nextRun.description: The next scheduled run of the processing.

webhookKey.title: Clé pour exécution à distance du traitement

oneOf.title: lecture - permet d'accéder aux informations essentielles du traitement dont les logs, mais pas aux informations sensibles
exécution - permet d'accéder aux informations essentielles du traitement et de déclencher le traitement

deleteOnComplete.description: If true, the run will be automatically deleted after completion

defaults.title: these limits were defined using default values only, not specifically defined

get.description: List the processings the session can read, with facets on their statuses, plugins and owners.

parameters.name: showAll
parameters.description: true to list the processings of every account (superadmin only).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort keys, comma separated, prefixed by - for descending order (e.g. -updated.date).

parameters.name: statuses
parameters.description: Statuses of the last run, comma separated (e.g. error,finished).

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Owners, comma separated, as type:id or type:id:department (e.g. organization:myorg).

x-agent.name: list_processings
x-agent.description: List the processings of the active account: periodic or on-demand tasks that run a plugin to ingest, transform or publish datasets. Each result tells its plugin, whether it is active, its last run and next scheduled run, and the profile of the caller on it (admin, exec or read). Use describe_processing for one processing.

q.description: Full text search on the titles.

statuses.description: Statuses of the last run, comma separated: triggered, scheduled, running, error, finished, kill, killed.

post.description: Create a processing of a plugin. The owner defaults to the active account; the processing is inactive until it has a valid config.

plugin.description: Registry artefact id of the plugin (e.g. @data-fair-processing-hello-world-1).

config.description: The config of the plugin, its schema is returned by getPluginConfigSchema.

x-agent.name: create_processing
x-agent.description: Create a processing of a plugin. The plugin id is the _id of a processing artefact found with registry_search_artefacts (category processing). The owner defaults to the active account. The processing is created inactive and without config: fill the config next with the processing_config tools, then activate it with update_processing.

get.description: Its config, permissions and webhook key are only returned to the admins of the processing.

x-agent.name: describe_processing
x-agent.description: Read a processing: its plugin, scheduling, activation, last and next runs. Its config and permissions are included when the caller is an admin of the processing.

patch.description: Update some parts of a processing. permissions and owner need the admin tier of the processings scopes. A null value removes a part.

config.description: The config of the plugin, its schema is returned by getPluginConfigSchema.

oneOf.title: lecture - permet d'accéder aux informations essentielles du traitement dont les logs, mais pas aux informations sensibles
exécution - permet d'accéder aux informations essentielles du traitement et de déclencher le traitement

x-agent.name: update_processing
x-agent.description: Rename a processing, activate or deactivate it, or replace its scheduling. A processing needs a valid config to be activated. The scheduling is the whole list of its schedules, an empty list for on-demand runs only. Use the processing_config tools for its config.

x-agent.name: update_processing_permissions

title.en: Update the permissions of a processing

x-agent.description: Replace the whole permissions list of a processing, which gives other users or partner organizations a read or exec profile on it, or give the processing to another owner. Read the current permissions first with describe_processing: the list sent replaces them all.

delete.description: Delete a processing and its runs.

x-agent.name: delete_processing
x-agent.description: Delete a processing permanently, its runs are deleted too. The datasets it published stay.

get.summary: Read the config of a processing
get.description: The config follows the schema returned by getPluginConfigSchema. Admins of the processing only.

200.description: The config, an empty object when the processing has none.

put.summary: Replace the config of a processing
put.description: Replace the whole config, validated against the schema returned by getPluginConfigSchema. Admins of the processing only.

x-agent.name: processing_config
x-agent.description: Edit the config of a processing, a form defined by the schema of its plugin.

get.summary: Read the config schema of a processing
get.description: The JSON schema of the config of the processing, defined by its plugin.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: true for the schema in json-layout v3 syntax, with the urls and owner filters of its layout resolved.

get.summary: Read the plugin of a processing
get.description: The metadata of the plugin version the processing runs.
List the runs of the processings the session can read, most recent first. Logs are not included.

parameters.name: processing
parameters.description: Id of the processing whose runs are listed.

parameters.name: showAll
parameters.description: true to list the processings of every account (superadmin only).

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Owners, comma separated, as type:id or type:id:department (e.g. organization:myorg).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort keys, comma separated, prefixed by - for descending order (e.g. -updated.date).

x-agent.name: list_runs
x-agent.description: List the runs of the processings of the active account, most recent first, without their logs. Each run tells its status (triggered, scheduled, running, error, finished, kill, killed) and its dates. Use describe_run for the log of one run.

processing.description: The _id of the processing whose runs are listed.

x-agent.name: describe_run
x-agent.description: Read a run with its log: the steps, infos, warnings and errors the plugin wrote. The tool to explain why a run failed. The log may quote data of external sources.

get.summary: Read the limits of an account
get.description: The processing time quota of an account and its consumption. Members of the account only.

post.description: Run an active processing now, or after a delay. With a webhook key the call needs no credentials.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The webhook key of the processing, instead of a session.

parameters.name: delay
parameters.description: Delay before the run, in seconds.

x-agent.name: trigger_processing
x-agent.description: Run a processing now, or after a delay, out of its scheduling. The processing must be active (an error 409 otherwise). Follow the run with list_runs and describe_run.

delay.description: Delay before the run starts, in seconds.

post.description: Ask the worker to stop a running run.

x-agent.name: kill_run
x-agent.description: Stop a running run: its status becomes kill until the worker stops it (killed). The work done by the plugin so far is not rolled back.

get.summary: Read the webhook key of a processing
get.description: The key that triggers the processing without credentials (triggerProcessing with key).

delete.summary: Renew the webhook key of a processing
delete.description: Replace the webhook key by a new one, the previous key stops working.
